items.title: KKR (KKR) Deepens Its Reach In Canadian Pipeline Infrastructure
items.summary: KKR (NYSE:KKR) has formed a new joint venture with Enbridge and Apollo to invest in the Westcoast Pipeline System in Canada, expanding its role in natural gas infrastructure. The partnership brings together energy, infrastructure and investment specialists to commit significant long term capital to Canadian midstream assets.
